messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "brief": "## Problem\nUsers experience mismatched data outputs despite submitting correct inputs, and encounter access issues even when role assignments appear accurate. This undermines trust in the platform's accuracy and usability.\n\n## Who is affected\n- 2 accounts have reported this problem via the support route [i:fc524069d591a3aa][i:fecead1bb8254bea].\n\n## Evidence\n- The problem has been reported 2 times [i:fc524069d591a3aa][i:fecead1bb8254bea].\n- All 2 mentions came through the 1 support route [i:fc524069d591a3aa][i:fecead1bb8254bea].\n- Duncastle Auto reported that everything looks correct, but the numbers still don’t match what we submitted last week [i:fc524069d591a3aa].\n- Ormsgill Cyber reported being under the impression I’m assigned the right role, but maybe something’s misconfigured on our end [i:fecead1bb8254bea].\n- The total Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) from the affected accounts is £215,000.0 [i:fc524069d591a3aa][i:fecead1bb8254bea].\n- Duncastle Auto contributes £80,000.0 of ARR and has a renewal date of 2027-08-19 [i:fc524069d591a3aa].\n- Ormsgill Cyber contributes £135,000.0 of ARR [i:fecead1bb8254bea].\n- There have been 0 renewals in the last 90 days [i:fc524069d591a3aa][i:fecead1bb8254bea].\n\n## Why now\n- The most recent report was made on 2026-10-28 [i:fecead1bb8254bea].\n- An earlier report was made on 2026-09-03 [i:fc524069d591a3aa].\n- The fact sheet data is current as of 2026-10-01, indicating the issue is active and unresolved [i:fc524069d591a3aa][i:fecead1bb8254bea].",
 "cited_insights": [
  {
   "id": "fc524069d591a3aa",
   "quote": "everything looks correct, but the numbers still don’t match what we submitted last week.",
   "account": "Duncastle Auto",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-09-03T13:25:00+00:00"
  },
  {
   "id": "fecead1bb8254bea",
   "quote": "I’m under the impression I’m assigned the right role, but maybe something’s misconfigured on our end.",
   "account": "Ormsgill Cyber",
   "route": "support",
   "date": "2026-10-28T08:26:00+00:00"
  }
 ],
 "fact_sheet": {
  "as_of": "2026-10-01",
  "accounts_n": 2,
  "mentions_n": 2,
  "routes_n": 1,
  "mentions_by_route": {
   "support": 2
  },
  "arr_total_gbp": 215000.0,
  "renewals_90d_n": 0,
  "accounts": [
   {
    "name": "Duncastle Auto",
    "arr_gbp": 80000.0,
    "renewal_date": "2027-08-19",
    "mentions": 1
   },
   {
    "name": "Ormsgill Cyber",
    "arr_gbp": 135000.0,
    "renewal_date": null,
    "mentions": 1
   }
  ]
 }
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "I checked every claim in the brief against the cited insights and fact sheet. The account count (2), mention count (2), single support route, total ARR (£215,000), Duncastle Auto's £80,000 ARR and 2027-08-19 renewal date, Ormsgill Cyber's £135,000 ARR, zero renewals in 90 days, and report dates (2026-09-03 and 2026-10-28) all match the evidence exactly. The quoted statements from both accounts are verbatim from the cited insights, and the paraphrased problem description (mismatched outputs despite correct inputs; access/role issues) is a fair reading of those quotes. The 2026-10-28 date is the most recent report, correctly cited, and the fact sheet date of 2026-10-01 is stated accurately with no contrary evidence omitted.", "verdict": "pass"}
